sections.h2: Which route sells a Collierville, TN house soonest?
sections.html:
A direct cash buyer is fastest, because there is no loan to arrange and the buyer takes the property without any fixes. An agent listing is still worth pricing out in Collierville, since a house in top shape can draw strong bids, but it brings preparation, showings and a lender's calendar.

Collierville is a town in Shelby County within the Memphis metropolitan area. Census counts show 51,324 residents in 2020 and an estimate of 51,909 for July 1, 2025.

  • Cash sale: a firm figure, no repair list, and a date you help pick.
  • Listing: a possibly higher price for a polished house, paid for with time.
  • Sale by owner: you skip the commission and take on the contract and disclosures.

Whichever way you lean, ask for a mortgage payoff figure and both tax balances, town and county, before anything else.

This is an affluent, owner-heavy community. For 2020 to 2024 the midpoint owned home is valued at $485,900. Owners live in 79.9% of housing units, and median household income is $138,598. On a house worth that much, the gap between a cash bid and a listing result can run to tens of thousands of dollars, so compare the two on a net basis.

Families dominate here: 26.8% of residents are under 18, the average household has 2.82 people, and 89.1% of people lived at the same address a year earlier. The average commute to work is 25.1 minutes. Collierville Schools serves the town, so confirm the school zone for your address and mention your commute routes when you describe the house.

  • Bedroom count and yard size matter to larger households.
  • Quick access to Interstate 269 or State Route 385 helps commuters.
  • Recent roof, HVAC and window work reassures buyers at this price level.

Spring is the severe weather season here, so buyers ask about roof age, hail damage and drainage near the foundation. If you replaced a roof or fixed wind damage, keep the invoice and any insurance claim file. A lender or insurer may request it, and a cash buyer can use it to set the price.

Walk the yard after a hard rain and note where water stands near the foundation. Buyers at this price level hire inspectors, and a seller who has already fixed or documented drainage, hail damage and roof age spends less time answering questions. If you plan a cash sale, none of this has to be repaired, but a short written summary of what you know helps the buyer make a firm offer faster.

sections.h2: Town and county tax bills in Collierville
sections.html:
A Collierville owner is billed by the Town of Collierville and by Shelby County. The town's rate is $1.62 per $100 of assessed value, and residential property is assessed at 25% of appraised value. The town's tax department answers at 901-457-2281.

The Shelby County Trustee takes payment from the first Monday of October to the last day of February. Collierville and Shelby County both set a March 1 delinquency date, and unpaid balances pick up 1.5% interest monthly, or 18% yearly. Mailed payments need a postmark dated no later than the last day of February. Trustee Customer Service is at 901-222-0200.

The closing company divides the current year's bill between you and the buyer. Request both balances a few days ahead so late interest does not catch you off guard.

sections.h2: What if I inherited a Collierville house?
sections.html:
Start with probate. Phone the Probate Court Clerk, 901-222-3750, to find out if a will was probated, because a probated will that names who receives the property can serve as the deed to it. If no will was probated, an affidavit of heirship is the document to file.

  • Find the death certificate, any will and the most recent deed.
  • Write down every heir, because each may have to sign or consent.
  • Get the title company to state in writing what it needs ahead of closing.

Selling an inherited house as is can spare you the expense of clearing out and repairing a property you may not want to keep. A direct buyer can adapt to the family's timeline, yet the paperwork must be complete before the deed can pass.

sections.h2: Recording at the Shelby County Register of Deeds
sections.html:
Deeds are filed and indexed at 1075 Mullins Station Road, Suite W165 in Memphis, where the office stays open on weekdays until 4:15 p.m. Expect a deed to be recorded and mailed back in roughly one business day, and many recorded documents can be viewed free online. In-office copies are $0.50 a page, and recording a quit claim deed typically costs $12.

The office records documents and cannot help draft them. An individual e-filing account can take 48 hours or more to open, so sellers usually leave filing to the title company. If the owner has died and no will is probated, Tennessee requires one affidavit of heirship, though most title companies prefer three from different witnesses.

For the tax side, the realty transfer tax falls on the grantee.

sections.h2: What a quick cash sale leaves out
sections.html:
No lender means no loan approval, no appraisal and no repair demands after an inspection. Staging and weeks of open houses drop away too. Title still has to be clear, every owner still signs the deed, and any mortgage still needs a payoff. With Collierville values this high, a wrong payoff figure or tax balance costs real money, so get the numbers in writing before the closing date.

Owed taxes are paid out of your proceeds at the closing table. Phone the Town's tax department and the Shelby County Trustee for exact balances, because interest of 1.5% a month starts after March 1.

Before accepting any offer, gather the deed, your payoff figures and the newest town and county tax bills. Work out who is named on the deed, because each of them signs, and carry a photo ID to the signing. Lenders add waiting time to a listing; a cash buyer with clean title often does not. Either way, the title company should draft the deed and send it for recording. Request the recorded copy afterward and file it with your tax papers. If something looks wrong on the closing statement, raise it with the title company before you sign, not after the deed is recorded. If you inherited the property, hand over the probate paperwork at the start so nobody discovers a missing signature late in the process.

faqs.q: Can a cash buyer take a Collierville house that needs no repairs?
faqs.a: Yes. Cash buyers also purchase well-kept houses. Compare the offer with a listing's net result, because a polished Collierville house can attract a strong market price.

faqs.q: What does Collierville charge in property tax?
faqs.a: The town rate is $1.62 per $100 of assessed value, with residential property assessed at 25% of appraised value. Shelby County bills its own tax separately.

faqs.q: When does Collierville tax go delinquent?
faqs.a: March 1. Unpaid amounts then pick up 1.5% interest each month.

faqs.q: How soon is a Shelby County deed recorded?
faqs.a: About one business day from receipt. A digital copy then appears on the register's website.

faqs.q: Who writes the deed in a Collierville sale?
faqs.a: Your title company, attorney or another real estate professional. The Register of Deeds only records documents and does not advise on preparing them.
